grounding.states: TSX is closed today, Monday Oct 12, for Thanksgiving; regular trading resumes Tuesday Oct 13
grounding.from: TMX Group said the Toronto Stock Exchange, TSX Venture Exchange, TSX Alpha Exchange and Montréal Exchange are closed Monday, October 12, 2026 for the Thanksgiving holiday. Regular trading resumes Tuesday, October 13.

grounding.states: Last session, Friday Oct 9, the S&P/TSX composite closed at 35,664.62, up 519.24 points (about 1.48%)
grounding.from: The S&P/TSX composite index was up 519.24 points at 35,664.62 (BNN Bloomberg/Canadian Press). That is a gain of about 1.48%. TMX Money and Yahoo Finance show the same close.

grounding.states: the rise was driven by weaker jobs data, which eased worries about the Bank of Canada hiking rates
grounding.from: Trading Economics attributed the gain to weaker employment data reinforcing expectations that the Bank of Canada will not hike rates.

value.answer: TSX is closed today, Monday, for Thanksgiving. It's back open tomorrow. Last session on Friday it closed at 35,664.62, up about 1.5% on the day, helped by weaker jobs numbers that eased worries about the Bank of Canada raising rates.
